title: BLUFF
premise: Everyone holds secret roles. Claim any power you like, call out the liars, and be the last one with a card.

rules.title: Win by being the last one standing
points: You start with {handSize} secret role cards and {startCoins} coins.
Lose all your cards and you're out.

rules.title: On your turn, do one thing
points: Foreign Aid: take {aid} coins. Anyone can block it.
Coup: pay {coupCost} and a player loses a card. You must at {mustCoupAt}+ coins.
Or claim a role and use its power.

rules.title: Claim any role, even one you don't have
points: Agent: pay {strikeCost}, and a player loses a card.
Broker: swap cards with the deck.

rules.title: Don't believe it? Challenge
points: Caught bluffing: they lose a card and the move fails.
Telling the truth: you lose a card, they draw a fresh one.
A block is a claim too, so it can be challenged.

rules.title: On your phone
points: Your moves are in the bottom bar. Tap a glowing player to aim one.
A gold banner means answer now: you have {responseSeconds} seconds.
The ? button shows these rules any time.
